item.title: Whiskers 0.8.50
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.50

### Recording Reliability

  • Improved recording startup and recovery when audio devices change, Bluetooth microphones wake slowly, or your Mac returns from sleep
  • Improved live dictation finalization so longer cloud dictation sessions finish more consistently
  • Improved text insertion after dictation so completed transcripts are pasted more reliably

    • ### Transcription & Models

  • Improved local and cloud transcription handling so Whiskers chooses ready models more consistently
  • Improved model download and validation reliability to reduce setup and startup issues
  • Improved bulk transcription handling for longer files, timestamps, and completed-result actions

    • ### Settings & Setup

  • Fixed recording shortcut setup so bare Fn hotkeys are saved correctly
  • Improved model and AI settings flows so provider setup, model choices, and saved keys behave more consistently
  • Improved onboarding and permission recovery so setup status reflects what Whiskers can actually use

    • ### Privacy, Support & Security

  • Improved support diagnostics with safer log exports, better attachment handling, and clearer privacy protections
  • Improved network trust checks for cloud services, promotions, licensing, and support requests
  • Improved license and quota checks so dictation and bulk transcription limits are applied more consistently
